rv: In fairness, they never said they would tear down a building with "historical significance". Not all old buildings are significant, some of them are buildings that just got old. Sometimes things *do* get old and outdated. I, for one, am glad I don't have to live and work in some old Victorian building with ugly angels and lions on it. What you call an "ugly steel & glass" structure, I call "normal". What's wrong with parking lots anyway? Do you have a car? Do you drive? Do you like not finding a parking space?
